[[Beta Kappa Chi]] is an American collegiate [[honor society]] that recognizes academic achievements in the fields of [[natural science]] and [[mathematics]]. It was established in 1923 at [[Lincoln University (Pennsylvania)|Lincoln University]], a [[Historically black university|historically Black university]] near [[Oxford, Pennsylvania]].<ref name=":0">Williams, Joseph L. "[http://www.jstor.org/stable/4604825 Betta Kappa Chi Honorary Scientific Society]." ''Bios'' vol. 15, no. 3 (October 1944): 137–39. {{JSTOR|4604825}}.</ref>

Beta Kappa Chi chapters were originally assigned [[Greek letter]] names in alphabetical order.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=Societies – Freddye T. Davy Honors College |url=https://home.hamptonu.edu/honors/societies/ |access-date=2024-09-08 |website=Hampton University |language=en-US}}</ref>  In 1950, the society abolished Greek letter names and renamed chapters by their host institutions.<ref name=":3" />

In the following list of Beta Kappa Chi chapters, inactive institutions are indicated in ''italics''.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2">Williams Joseph L. "[https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC2616064/?page=1 Beta Kappa Chi: A Challenge Not To Be Ignored]." ''Journal of the National Medical Association'', vol. ''37, no.'' 1 (January 1945): 26. via PubMed Central.</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=June 7, 2011 |title=Beta Kappa Chi Honor Society Chapters, ACHS |url=http://www.achsnatl.org/SocResults.asp?Society=bkc |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120414194017/http://www.achsnatl.org/SocResults.asp?Society=bkc |archive-date=2012-04-14 |access-date=2024-09-08 |website=Association of College Honor Societies |via=web.archive.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Our Chapters |url=https://www.betakappachi.org/chapters/our-chapters |access-date=2024-09-08 |website=Beta Kappa Chi}}</ref><ref name =Hist>[https://betaappachi.org/about-us/our-history History of Beta Kappa Chi Scientific Honor Society - 1923-1984 by Leroy D. Johnson]</ref>
